name: Robbie Donaldson
tagline: True stories, three chords, New York City.
bio: Robbie Donaldson writes country folk the old way: true stories, three chords, and whatever the room gives back. The songs sit somewhere between a letter home and a last call.
He grew up on classic country records and learned early that a song only counts if it holds up in a quiet room with one guitar. No tricks, no backing tracks. Just the song.

In 2026 he packed everything into a couple of cases and moved to New York City. These days you'll find him in small rooms and on street corners across the five boroughs, playing for anyone who slows down long enough to listen, and putting together his first EP.
bookingFacts: Solo acoustic act: guitar, harmonica and a long memory for requests
Sets from 45 minutes to three hours
Originals plus a deep book of classic country covers
Based in Brooklyn, travels anywhere the songs are wanted
